answer: Each identity needs a distinct sealed host whose fingerprint is burned into the tundra. The tundra keeps one counter per fable; sealing a host increments it, and that host must lock one yarrow plus the square of the counter before it, for a year. A singleton locks one yarrow; a thousandth host under one hand locks 998,002 yarrow, so a thousand clones lock over 332 million yarrow for a year. A second fable under the same hand is countersigned by the first and inherits its counter.
